references.title: Integrating multiplexed imaging and multiscale modeling identifies tumor phenotype conversion as a critical component of therapeutic T cell efficacy
references.author: Hickey, John W. and Agmon, Eran and Horowitz, Nina and Tan, Tze-Kai and Lamore, Matthew and Sunwoo, John B. and Covert, Markus W. and Nolan, Garry P.
references.note: Original tumor-tcell Vivarium model + CODEX multiplexed imaging of B16-F10 melanoma. Central finding: the RATE of IFNg-driven tumor phenotype conversion (PDL1n/MHC-I-low -> PDL1p/MHC-I-high, G0-arrested), not the raw number of T-cell kills, governs therapeutic efficacy.
